about_the_game:
EASY DELIVERY
Use the hand truck to unload large deliveries easily. You can also organize boxes or transport them to storage with the hand truck.


RESTOCK SHELVES
Restock the shelves and keep your supermarket fully stocked at all times. Keep your shelves organized


HANDLE PAYMENTS
Process cash or credit card payments quickly with easy-to-use UIs. Serve customers on time and prevent long queues to keep your supermarket running smoothly.


INSTALL VENDING MACHINES
Manually handling every customer’s payment can be tiring. Place vending machines outside and let customers serve themselves while you earn passive income. Do not forget to keep them restocked


KEEP CLEAN
Keep your store clean by removing empty boxes. You can even use the hand truck to collect and transport them to the trash bin in piles.

name: Urban Supermarket Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Urban Supermarket Simulator is a city-based supermarket simulator game. Use forklifts, pallet jacks, and hand trucks to unload large deliveries, manage grocery inventory, hire staff, handle payments. Install vending machines to the city to earn passive income and grow your store.
